title: The moon with rivers and seas of liquid methane
description: Titan is the only moon in our solar system with a thick atmosphere and liquid on its surface. NASA's Dragonfly mission will soon fly across this frozen world to study its chemistry.

shots.narration: Titan is bigger than the planet Mercury and is wrapped in a thick nitrogen atmosphere.
The surface pressure is 1.5 times Earth's, but the temperature is minus 180 degrees Celsius.
At these temperatures, the rivers and lakes are filled with liquid methane and ethane.
Kraken Mare, the largest sea on Titan, is even bigger than the Caspian Sea on Earth.
On 14 January 2005, the Huygens probe parachuted for two and a half hours to reach the surface.
This was the farthest landing ever made, and the probe transmitted from the ground for 72 minutes.
NASA's Dragonfly rotorcraft is scheduled to launch in 2028 to explore this distant world.
The mission will fly across the moon in the 2030s to study its unique environment.
Watch as this robotic drone prepares to navigate the thick atmosphere of a methane-rich world.
